name: Air-Fryer Tofu Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 10 large button mushrooms, stems removed and finely chopped
½ tsp each dried oregano and black pepper
steps: Heat the oil and cook the garlic and mushroom stems for 3 minutes; add the spinach and cook 2 minutes.
Mix with the tofu, nutritional yeast, oregano, pepper and salt.
Cook the mushrooms for 10–12 minutes until tender and golden on top.
note: Low-carbohydrate and quick; makes a good starter or light lunch.
